decision: replace the stale staged staff-automation concept with a fresh managed lead-generation service package
commercial_objective: qualified Sydney owner conversations for a fully managed lead-generation service

reference_evidence.seal: Full-bleed coastal wildlife, a one-second competitive metaphor and large condensed white copy.
reference_evidence.crab: Full-bleed outdoor action, a bold two-line RUN LIGHTER headline and restrained explanatory labels.
reference_evidence.beach: Aspirational coastal photography, a direct owner question and selective warm-yellow emphasis.
reference_evidence.design_rule: Use the outdoor editorial language and hierarchy, but create a new subject, photograph, composition and commercial message.

candidates.concept: A lighthouse beam guides three small boats toward harbour
candidates.reason: It makes the service and its accountable path understandable at a glance, fits the coastal reference language and avoids an invented outcome claim.

candidates.concept: Gulls compete for one chip while one bird watches the source
candidates.reason: Strong visual tension, but attraction language can imply passive demand generation and understate the managed service.

candidates.concept: A tidal channel turns scattered water into one clear course
candidates.reason: Clearly communicates routing, but the lead-generation service itself is less visible.

candidates.concept: A single lifeguard flag stands clearly above a crowded shore
candidates.reason: Good attention metaphor, but says little about capture, qualification or follow-up.

candidates.concept: Footprints leave the beach and reach an open business doorway
candidates.reason: Commercially direct, but an appointment promise is too strong without evidence of qualification and booking performance.

candidates.concept: A pelican fishes while the owner steps away from the water
candidates.reason: Memorable, but playful language weakens professional-service buyer fit.

candidates.concept: A rockpool feeds several natural channels from one source
candidates.reason: The mechanism is relevant, but the photograph would require more explanation than one second allows.

candidates.concept: Small boats pass a harbour entrance while looking elsewhere
candidates.reason: Useful follow-up tension, but negative framing is less distinctive than the selected accountable-service promise.

winner.question: What should a fully managed lead generation service include?
winner.buyer: Owners of established Sydney small-to-medium B2B and professional-service businesses
winner.offer: Campaign planning, creative, Meta advertising, lead capture, routing, follow-up and reporting as one managed service.
winner.human_boundary: The owner approves positioning, audience and offer and keeps the sales conversation. Run Lighter operates the repeatable campaign and lead-handling system.
